lines.text: Many learners say: I have many work today.
Better: I have a lot of work today.
Work has no number. Use much or a lot of.
Much! I don't have much work today.

data.right: I have a lot of work today.
data.why: Work has no number. Use much or a lot of.

native.tip: “Work” ne se compte pas : pas de “many”. Dites “a lot of work”.

en.tip: “Work” is not countable, so no “many”. Say “a lot of work”.
